description: Caller Avoidance Score (callers-avoid-0.1, outcome-only; honesty deferred): toxicity / avoid grade for a Crypto Twitter handle from public-call follower sim (post+5m, fees). Returns avoid_score 0-100, band, components with receipts (sim_mean, sim_win_rate, rug_rate, hit_2x_24h + Wilson CI), verdict (copy_buy_loses|insufficient_sample|mixed), and public post id links — not full post text. Free when n_scored<4 via GET /v0/callers/score. Not financial advice. PAID: $0.02 USDC per call on Base via x402 (MCP transport: retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over plain HTTP: GET /v1/callers/score.
name: caller_avoidance_score
